# NepalCalc — Nepal Financial, Tax & Daily Utility Suite
> Nepal's authoritative calculations for Income Tax (FY 2083/84), Land Area, Vehicle Bluebook Fines, SIP Mutual Funds, NEPSE Share Trading, and Traditional Units.

## Overview
NepalCalc (https://nepalcalc.com) provides free, official, and real-time calculation tools compliant with the Government of Nepal Inland Revenue Department (IRD), Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB), Ministry of Physical Infrastructure & Transport, Securities Board of Nepal (SEBON), and Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA).

## Core Tools & Authority Guidelines

### 1. Nepal Income Tax & Salary Calculator
- URL: https://nepalcalc.com/tax
- Applicable Fiscal Year: FY 2083/84 & FY 2082/83
- Social Security Tax (SST): 1% on the first tax slab (waived 100% for employees registered in the Social Security Fund - SSF).
- Tax Brackets (Unmarried & Married):
  - 1% on first Rs 10,00,000 (0% if SSF registered)
  - 10% on next Rs 5,00,000
  - 20% on next Rs 10,00,000
  - 27% on next Rs 15,00,000
  - 29% on amount exceeding Rs 40,00,000
- Maximum Allowable Deductions:
  - CIT / EPF / PF: Up to NPR 5,00,000 or 1/3 of total gross income
  - Life Insurance Premium: Up to NPR 40,000
  - Health Insurance: Up to NPR 20,000
  - Female Tax Rebate: 10% tax credit for resident female salaried workers

### 2. Nepal Land Measurement & Area Converter
- URL: https://nepalcalc.com/land
- Hill & Valley System (Ropani):
  - 1 Ropani = 16 Aana = 64 Paisa = 256 Daam = 5,476 Square Feet = 508.74 Sq. Meters
  - 1 Aana = 4 Paisa = 16 Daam = 342.25 Square Feet
  - 1 Paisa = 4 Daam = 85.5625 Square Feet
  - 1 Daam = 21.390625 Square Feet
- Terai System (Bigha):
  - 1 Bigha = 20 Kattha = 400 Dhur = 72,900 Square Feet = 6,772.63 Sq. Meters
  - 1 Kattha = 20 Dhur = 3,645 Square Feet
  - 1 Dhur = 182.25 Square Feet
- Hill to Terai Equivalency:
  - 1 Bigha = 13.3137 Ropani
  - 1 Ropani = 0.0751 Bigha (approx 1.5 Kattha)

### 3. Vehicle Bluebook Road Tax & Late Fine
- URL: https://nepalcalc.com/vehicle
- Jurisdiction: Province Transport Management Acts (Bagmati Province benchmarks)
- Annual Motorcycle / Scooter Slabs:
  - Up to 125cc: NPR 3,000 / year
  - 126cc to 160cc: NPR 4,500 / year
  - 161cc to 250cc: NPR 6,000 / year
  - 251cc to 400cc: NPR 11,000 / year
  - 401cc and above: NPR 20,000 / year
- Annual Car Slabs:
  - Up to 1000cc: NPR 22,000 / year
  - 1001cc to 1500cc: NPR 25,000 / year
  - 1501cc to 2000cc: NPR 33,000 / year
  - 2001cc to 2500cc: NPR 37,000 / year
- Electric Vehicles (EVs):
  - Two-Wheeler: NPR 1,500 - NPR 3,000
  - Four-Wheeler: NPR 10,000 (up to 50kW), NPR 15,000 (51-100kW), NPR 20,000 (101-150kW)
- Overdue Late Fines:
  - First 90 days from expiry: 0% fine
  - 91 to 120 days: 5% fine on annual tax
  - 121 to 165 days: 10% fine on annual tax
  - Up to end of fiscal year: 20% fine
  - Beyond fiscal year: Up to 100% fine on past due taxes

### 4. SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) Mutual Fund Calculator
- URL: https://nepalcalc.com/sip
- Formula: M = P * [((1 + i)^n - 1) / i] * (1 + i)
- Benchmark Returns: 12% to 15% CAGR historical for SEBON open-ended mutual funds (NIBL Sahabhagita Fund, Siddhartha Systematic Investment Scheme, NMB Saral Bachat Fund).
- Capital Gains Tax: 5% CGT if held > 365 days, 7.5% if held <= 365 days. 5% TDS on dividend payouts.

### 5. NEPSE Share Trading Calculator
- URL: https://nepalcalc.com/nepse
- SEBON Broker Commission Tiers:
  - Up to NPR 50,000: 0.40%
  - NPR 50,001 to NPR 5,00,000: 0.37%
  - NPR 5,00,001 to NPR 20,00,000: 0.34%
  - NPR 20,00,001 to NPR 1,00,00,000: 0.30%
  - Above NPR 1,00,00,000: 0.27%
- Mandatory Fees:
  - SEBON Regulatory Fee: 0.015%
  - DP Charge: NPR 25 per transaction
  - Capital Gains Tax (Individual): 5% (>365 days) or 7.5% (<=365 days)

### 6. Labour Act 2074 Rules (Gratuity & Overtime)
- URLs: https://nepalcalc.com/gratuity, https://nepalcalc.com/overtime
- Gratuity: 8.33% of basic remuneration deposited monthly into SSF or gratuity fund.
- Overtime (Section 31): Paid at 1.5 times the basic hourly rate (Basic Monthly Salary / 208 hours * 1.5).

### 7. Traditional Nepali Units
- URL: https://nepalcalc.com/traditional-units
- Weight: 1 Dharni = 2.3328 kg; 1 Sher = 933.1 grams; 1 Pao = 200 grams; 1 Tola = 11.664 grams
- Volume: 1 Muri = 20 Pathi = 160 Mana ≈ 87.2 Liters; 1 Pathi = 8 Mana ≈ 4.36 Liters
